bias.en: Neutral to bearish · lost the 30-day average
bias.zh: 中性偏空 · 跌破 30 日均线

read.en: Bloom Energy fell 6.5% on Oct 12 to $262.28, closing under its 30-day average ($267) for the first time since late September. It is also below the 5 and 10-day averages ($281–282) but above the rising 100-day ($254) and 200-day ($213). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8, Parabolic SAR turned bearish the same day, and RSI is 48.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 10月12日下跌 6.5%，收于 $262.28，自 9月下旬以来首次收在 30 日均线（$267）下方。股价同时位于 5 日和 10 日均线（$281–282）下方，但仍高于上行的 100 日（$254）和 200 日均线（$213）。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方，抛物线 SAR 同日转空，RSI 为 48。

read.en: The $265 support (Oct 8 low) broke intraday to $257.78. Next is $251–254 (Sep 24 low and 100-day average), then the June pivot at $229 and $197.5 (Sep 1 low). Resistance is the 30-day average at $267, then $280–282 (5 and 10-day averages, Oct 9 close) and $300–303, which has capped the stock since May.
read.zh: $265 支撑（10月8日低点）盘中失守，低见 $257.78。下一支撑为 $251–254（9月24日低点及 100 日均线），其次 6月转折点 $229 及 $197.5（9月1日低点）。阻力为 $267 的 30 日均线，其次 $280–282（5 日、10 日均线及 10月9日收盘价），以及自 5月以来压制股价的 $300–303。

r.en: Sep 29 and Oct 6 highs; capped since May
r.zh: 9月29日及10月6日高点；5月以来压力
